title: Marry Me Salad
description: A simple and life-changing iceberg lettuce salad that is quick to prepare and incredibly flavorful.

ingredients.item: Salt, about the size of a flat quarter in your hand

steps: Place the shredded lettuce in a bowl.
Add the lemon juice, olive oil, salt, grated garlic, pepper, and a splash of white vinegar.
Mix everything together thoroughly until well incorporated.
notes:
You can customize this salad by adding ingredients like peppers or feta cheese on top.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/v/1aY7TxTBpy/

Nutrition: Serving 1 serving · Calories 120 kcal · Fat 10g · Saturated fat 1.5g · Unsaturated fat 8g · Trans fat 0g · Cholesterol 0mg · Sodium 350mg · Carbs 6g · Fiber 2g · Sugar 2g · Protein 1g

healthy: Olive oil dressing is mostly unsaturated fat.
Lemon and garlic add flavor without sugar.
not_healthy: Iceberg lettuce is light on vitamins and fiber compared with darker greens.
A generous handful of salt makes it high in sodium.
